title: More Informative Console
description: Information panel for the reference selected in the console. Changes apply the next time the console updates.

Panel.label: Also print to console history
Panel.hint: Prints the same information into the console each time you click a new reference.

Panel.label: Scale
Panel.hint: Scales the whole panel, text included.

Panel.label: Font size
Panel.hint: 0 uses the console's own text size.
